revenue.loc: FS2020 PDF p. 8, Penjualan neto, 2019 column (as restated)

research_notes: Name and business: legal name PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (unchanged through the 9M2026 FS, authorised 30 Oct 2026). Integrated poultry: animal feed, day-old chicks, broilers and processed chicken (Golden Fiesta, Fiesta, Champ, Okey...). Parent PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Group holds 55.53% (FS2025 Note 20). Listed on IDX since 18 Mar 1991. IDR reporter; FS in Rp juta, all money here IDR billion (/1,000), exact to the printed figure.

Source policy: FY2020-FY2025 levels, profit, EPS and cash flows from each year's own audited consolidated FS (auditor Purwantono, Sungkoro & Surja / EY); all documents downloaded directly from cp.co.id (no bot protection; the server omits its TLS intermediate certificate, so curl was given the RapidSSL TLS RSA CA G1 intermediate from the certificate's own AIA URL - see sources.md). Comparatives in later FS agree with the originals for 2020-2024 (FS2023 reclassified some 2022 current assets, total assets unchanged; 9M2026 Note 42 moved 450 bn of the 2025 bank loans from short- to long-term, total unchanged).

FY2019 restatement (doubt for reviewer): FS2020 adopted PSAK 72 fully retrospectively (Note 2b, Note 43 PDF p. 153-155: partnership transactions with contract broiler farmers). FY2019 net sales fell from 58,634.5 bn to 42,501.1 bn, profit attributable rose 10.1 bn, total assets fell 243.6 bn, equity attributable fell 175.7 bn. fy.2019 stores the AS RESTATED figures from FS2020 so that FY2020 growth is like-for-like; the originally published FS2019 values are quoted in each fy.2019 note. FY2020 onward are on the PSAK 72 basis throughout.

EBITDA is not reported by CPIN (no EBITDA in any AR highlights/MD&A, no results releases or decks on cp.co.id; only loan covenants mention it), so every ebitda datum is null. ROE/ROA are not stored: the AR highlights print them only as two-decimal fractions (AR2025 PDF p. 3: ROA 0,12 / ROE 0,16 for 2025, where profit/total equity = 0.165), too coarse to be useful.

total_debt = short-term bank loans + long-term (syndicated) bank loans. Short-term loans include a JP Morgan Chase overdraft in 2021-2023 (136.9 / 349.2 / 92.8 bn), which is why the cash-flow statement's closing cash is lower than balance-sheet cash in those years. Lease liabilities (PSAK 73, from 2020) are excluded; royalty payables to the CP Group IP holder ('Utang pihak berelasi') are not debt. No bonds/MTN/sukuk outstanding in any year.

capex = 'Perolehan aset tetap' (acquisition of fixed assets) only. Advances for purchase of fixed assets (13-55 bn a year) and right-of-use additions are excluded; breeder flocks (biological assets) are not an investing line in CPIN's cash-flow statement.

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: none. The share chronology (AR2025 PDF p. 28; FS2025 Note 1b; cp.co.id/?p=78) ends with the 2010 par-value split Rp50 -> Rp10 and the 2010 redemption of 24,807,040 shares, leaving 16,398,000,000 shares, which is the count in every FS from 2019 to 9M2026. No treasury shares. corporate_actions is therefore an empty list and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Dividends: FY2020 final Rp112, FY2021 final Rp108, FY2022 none (AGMS 22 May 2023 retained the whole profit; payout_ratio 0), FY2023 interim Rp100 (Nov 2023) + final Rp30 (Jun 2024) = Rp130 / 91.94%, FY2024 final Rp108, FY2025 final Rp180. The FY2019 final (Rp81, paid 16 Sep 2020) is out of scope. Dates from the company's schedule notices; DPS/totals also in the dividend history page cp.co.id/?p=80 and FS equity statements. No FY2026 interim dividend had been announced as of the 9M2026 FS (30 Oct 2026).

Year-end prices are the Q4 closes in each year's AR 'Informasi Saham' table (AR2020: 6,525; AR2021: 5,950; AR2022: 5,650; AR2023: 5,025; AR2024: 4,760; AR2025: 4,510); each matches the printed market capitalisation / 16,398,000,000. share_basis = the AR PDF creation date (publication proxy); irrelevant for adjustment since there was no split after 2010.

9M2026: operating cash flow was only 113.9 bn (9M2025: 4,015.1 bn) while inventories rose to 17,789.6 bn (31 Dec 2025: 11,406.2 bn, PDF p. 2) and bank debt to 11,197.7 bn (6,304.1 bn); total assets 53,269 bn vs 45,858 bn at end-2025; profit attributable +54% YoY.
